title: Core Septet #06
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, seven women in a single row.

A photograph of SEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 7 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Ao Dai Glam / Muscle Hourglass]: Vietnamese woman, late 40s, cheerful, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, braided hair, round nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame. Shoes: extreme silver platform stiletto cross-strap sandals.

[Hong Kong-style / Polynesian Goddess]: Chinese woman, late 50s, sultry, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, hair set in glossy voluminous old-film waves, a poised, glamorous expression, braided hair, coffin nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 7, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
